title: Just Vanilla+
description: Bored From Minecraft Vanilla? Play "Just Vanilla+" and rediscover Minecraft !
body:
## Just Vanilla+

**Just Vanilla+** is a lightweight modpack that keeps the **heart of Minecraft** intact while adding **subtle improvements** to enhance your experience. It’s perfect for players who love the **vanilla feel** but want **smoother gameplay**, **smarter tweaks**, and a touch of polish. Rediscover Minecraft **without losing what made it special.**

-------------------------------------

**Just Vanilla+** keeps **the classic Minecraft feel** while adding small **quality-of-life** tweaks, **smoother performance**, and a few smart **extras**. **It’s still the game you know, just more polished and enjoyable.**

-----

If You Find Any **Issue** In My **Modpakc(s)** Or You Want To Give Us **suggest feature**,report it on [CortexDev-Support](https://github.com/CortexDev-Official/CortexDev-Support/issues)
